:::{#def-mvn}
#### Multivariate normal distribution (multivariate Gaussian distribution)

A $p \times 1$ random vector $\vX = \tp{(X_1, \ldots, X_p)}$
has the **multivariate normal distribution**
(or **multivariate Gaussian distribution**)
with mean parameter $\vecf{\mean} \in \reals^p$
and variance parameter $\matr{\covmat}$,
a $p \times p$
[positive definite](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-positive-definite)
matrix,
written $\vX \sim \Normal_p\paren{\vecf{\mean}, \matr{\covmat}}$,
if $\vX$ has joint density:

$$
\p(\vX = \vx) \eqdef
\frac{1}{(2\pi)^{p/2} \det(\matr{\covmat})^{1/2}}
\ef{-\frac{1}{2} \tp{(\vx - \vecf{\mean})} \matr{\covmat}^{-1} (\vx - \vecf{\mean})},
\quad \vx \in \reals^p
$$

where $\det(\matr{\covmat})$ is the
[determinant](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-determinant)
of $\matr{\covmat}$
and $\matr{\covmat}^{-1}$ is its
[inverse](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-matrix-inverse).

:::
